panelTabFeatures.description: Panel tab that lists the features of the site being viewed

panelTabSites.description: Panel tab that lists the sites Voyager can reach

panelTabCreate.description: Panel tab where the user asks the page's AI to write a plugin (Create mode)

panelCreateIntro.message: Di qué debería cambiar en este sitio. La IA de aquí escribe un plugin y Voyager te ofrece instalarlo desde la respuesta.
panelCreateIntro.description: Create tab: what Create mode does, above the request field

panelCreateUnsupported.message: El modo creación aún no funciona en este sitio.
panelCreateUnsupported.description: Create tab on a website where Create mode does not run

panelCreateHint.message: Crear en esta página abre un chat nuevo aquí con tu petición en el cuadro de mensaje. Léela y envíala tú.
panelCreateHint.description: Create tab: what the Create on this page button does; nothing is sent

panelCreateOnPage.description: Create tab button: open a new chat on this page with the creation message

panelCreateWeakModel.message: {model} de {site} no suele poder escribir un plugin.
panelCreateWeakModel.description: Create tab warning title: {site} is the chat site (Gemini), {model} the model it shows (Flash), which usually cannot write a plugin

panelCreateWeakModelThinking.message: {model} de {site} con razonamiento {thinking} no suele poder escribir un plugin.
panelCreateWeakModelThinking.description: Create tab warning title with the thinking level: {site} the chat site, {model} the model, {thinking} its thinking level as the site names it (Low)

panelCreateWeakModelAdvice.message: Elige {suggested} o un modelo más potente en el menú de modelos de {site}, o pasa tu petición a un agente de programación local. Aun así puedes crear en esta página.
panelCreateWeakModelAdvice.description: Create tab warning: the two ways out; {suggested} is a stronger model on the site (Argon), {site} the chat site. Creating on the page stays possible

panelCreateCheckModel.description: Create tab warning button: read the model the page shows again, after the user changed it

panelCreateStructure.message: Añadir cómo está construida esta página, sin nada de su texto, para que la IA escriba para lo que hay aquí
panelCreateStructure.description: Create tab: label of the switch (on by default) that adds the structure of this page, without its text, to the request

panelCreateStructureShow.description: Create tab: fold that shows the exact page structure text added to the request

panelCreateStructureReading.description: Create tab: the page structure is being read from the page

panelCreateStructureUnavailable.message: Esta página no respondió. Recárgala para ver lo que se añade.
panelCreateStructureUnavailable.description: Create tab: the page did not answer when asked for its structure

panelCreateUnavailable.message: Esta página no respondió. Recárgala y vuelve a intentarlo.
panelCreateUnavailable.description: Create tab: the page's content script did not answer the request

panelCreateReviewTitle.description: Create tab: heading of the review of a plugin picked under an AI reply

panelCreateChecking.description: Create tab: the picked reply is being checked

panelCreateInstalling.description: Create tab: the reviewed plugin is being installed and turned on

panelCreateInstallNote.message: Se activa al momento. Desactívalo cuando quieras en Funciones.
panelCreateInstallNote.description: Create tab: what the install button does

panelCreateInstall.description: Create tab button: install the reviewed plugin and turn it on

panelCreateUpdate.description: Create tab button: replace the installed plugin with the reviewed version and turn it on

panelCreateRejectedHint.message: Usa «Devolver los problemas a la IA» bajo la respuesta y Voyager te ofrecerá la versión corregida cuando llegue.
panelCreateRejectedHint.description: Create tab: where to send the problems of a refused plugin

panelCreateInstalledOn.description: Create tab: the plugin is installed and on. Keep {name}

panelCreateInstalledOff.message: {name} está instalado pero sigue desactivado: el navegador no concedió el acceso al sitio que necesita.
panelCreateInstalledOff.description: Create tab: installed, but the browser did not grant the site access it needs. Keep {name}

panelCreateTurnOn.description: Create tab button: try again to turn on the installed plugin

panelCreateReload.message: Si una versión anterior estaba en marcha, recarga la página para usar esta.
panelCreateReload.description: Create tab: an earlier version with a native op keeps running until reload

panelCreateChangeAgain.message: ¿Quieres un cambio? Díselo a la IA en este chat y Voyager te ofrecerá la nueva versión bajo su respuesta.
panelCreateChangeAgain.description: Create tab: how to change the installed plugin again

panelCreateFoundIn.description: Create tab, after an install: where the creation is now; {features} is the Features tab name, {creations} the My creations group name

panelCreateFailed.message: Voyager no pudo instalarlo. No se cambió nada.
panelCreateFailed.description: Create tab: the install failed; nothing was installed

panelTabsLabel.description: Accessible name of the panel tab list

panelSearch.description: Search field and button that filter the feature rows

panelFullSettings.description: Button that opens the full Voyager settings (toolbar popup)

panelEntryGroup.description: Group label above the floating button row: ways to open Voyager on the page

panelFloatingButton.description: Row for Prompt Manager's floating button on the page

panelShortcutHint.message: Abre el panel cuando el botón está oculto
panelShortcutHint.description: Tooltip on the shortcut key cap beside the floating button switch

panelThisPage.description: Mark beside the page's own site in the site menu

panelNotThisPage.message: {site} · No es esta página, así que los cambios no se previsualizan
panelNotThisPage.description: Tooltip of the site switcher while another site is viewed; {site} is the site name

panelNoMatches.description: Shown when a feature search finds nothing

panelSupportedSites.description: Group label above the supported sites card

panelOtherWebsitesGroup.description: Label above added websites, where only Prompt Manager runs; {websites} is the popup's "Other websites" title

panelFeaturesOn_many.description: Under a supported site: how many features are on there

panelNotEnabled.description: Under a supported site Voyager cannot reach yet

panelWaitingForBrowser.description: Under a supported site while the browser's permission prompt is open

panelAllowAccess.description: Accessible name of a site's access switch; {site} is the site name

panelRemoveWebsite.description: Accessible name of the remove button of an added website; {site} is its host

panelCreationRemoveAsk.message: ¿Quitar {name} de este navegador? No se puede deshacer.
panelCreationRemoveAsk.description: Features tab: asked under a creation before removing it; {name} is the creation

panelRemoveCreationFailed.message: Voyager no pudo quitar {name}. Inténtalo de nuevo.
panelRemoveCreationFailed.description: Toast: storage refused to remove a creation; {name} is the creation

panelSyncSharedDetail.description: Sub-line under the Shared row: what it contains

panelSyncMore.description: Accessible name of the sheet's more-actions button

panelSyncDone_many.description: Toast after a sync: how many rows were synced
